Whereas the Loudoun County School Board has convened a closed meeting on this date

pursuant to an affirmative recorded vote and in attendance with the provisions of the Virginia Freedom of Information Act, and whereas Code 2.2-3712D of the Code of Virginia requires a certification by the school board that such closed meeting was conducted in conformity with Virginia law.
